policy: No external, scraped, or hotlinked imagery. No dataset photos are fabricated; where the dataset has no images, abstract original plates are used and never presented as user evidence.
creation: All three plates are hand-authored original SVG compositions (geometric arcs, dots, type) — no AI-image generator and no photographic sourcing involved, so no prompts, licensing, attribution, or mobile photographic variants apply. Responsive behavior: SVGs scale losslessly to any viewport (vector); ParallaxFigure renders them at container width with focal-safe symmetric compositions that crop gracefully.
optimization: Each SVG is under 4 KB, inlined via with loading=lazy; no raster variants needed.
